summary: UC1: Receive tray notification on event creation
user_story: As a community member, I want to receive a notification tray item when a new event is created in my community, so that I can find and RSVP to it in a single tap.
value_rationale: Reduces the path from awareness → RSVP from multiple steps to one.
preconditions: An event has been created in a community on the network
entry_points: A. Event created in a community the user belongs to

push_message.example: "Ulta Beauty Community has event Ulta Beauty World Masterclass 2026" / [In-person]  10 Jul 2026 · 7:00 PM
notes: {{EventType}} renders as a pill/chip label: In-person for in-person events, Virtual for virtual/livestream events
{{EventStartDate}} and {{EventStartTime}} refer to the scheduled start of the event (not current time)
Tapping deep-links to the event RSVP page (destination = event detail page where RSVP action is visible)
Each event creation generates its own distinct tray item — notifications are NOT grouped

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tray item created for community members on event creation
given: A user is an active, non-banned member of a community
acceptance_criteria.when: A moderator creates an event in that community
then: The primary line reads "{{CommunityName}} has event {{EventName}}"
The secondary line shows an event type chip followed by the event start date and start time
The item displays the community avatar
The item is marked as unseen

given: A moderator creates an IN-PERSON event
then: The secondary line shows an "In-person" chip followed by the event start date and start time

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Virtual / livestream event — event type chip
given: A moderator creates a VIRTUAL event
then: The secondary line shows a "Virtual" chip followed by the event start date and start time

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Public community event — notify entire network
given: An event is created in a PUBLIC community
then: All active, non-banned users in the network receive the notification

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Private community event — only notify community members
given: An event is created in a PRIVATE community
then: Only active, non-banned members of that community receive the notification
